name: lila-meals
description: Explore 649 recipes from Lila, the perimenopause app, and build practical cooking plans and shopping lists for midlife.

interface.longDescription:
Find practical recipes and plan meals for midlife and perimenopause. Explore 649 recipes from Lila, the perimenopause app, and turn its recipe library into a practical menu you can cook this week.

Made for people navigating perimenopause who want less work deciding what to cook. Find quick meals, filter by protein or fiber per serving, choose food preferences and ingredients, adjust household servings, and swap a meal when your plans change. Finish with a consolidated shopping list, including pantry staples.

Get real recipe ingredients, cooking instructions, estimated nutrition and source links from Lila’s library, directly in ChatGPT. No Lila account is required.

General cooking and meal-planning guidance. Nutrition values are estimates. The plugin does not diagnose perimenopause, prescribe clinical diets or provide symptom treatment. Check ingredient labels when allergy safety matters.
defaultPrompt: Plan five practical dinners for midlife and perimenopause, for two people, and make the shopping list.
Find quick meals from Lila’s recipe library with plenty of protein and no dairy.
Swap one dinner and update my shopping list.

positive.prompt: Find salmon dinners with at least 25g protein per serving and a cooking time of 35 minutes or less.
positive.expected_behavior: Return actual matching Lila catalog recipes, per-serving nutrition estimates and recipe source links.

positive.prompt: Show Lila recipe 002-tuna-white-bean-salad for four people with US measurements.
positive.expected_behavior: Return ingredients scaled from per-serving quantities to four servings, all cooking steps and a clear note about the original instruction serving count.

positive.prompt: Plan five lower-cost dinners for two. Leave out dairy, keep each under 25 minutes, and choose recipes with at least 25g protein per serving. Include the shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Return five distinct recipes that preserve all requested filters and a consolidated list including pantry staples. Do not interpret dairy avoidance as a medical diagnosis.

positive.prompt: Make a five-day dinner plan for two, avoiding dairy, with lower-cost recipes under 25 minutes and at least 25g protein per serving. Then change the dinner on day two while preserving all other meals and preferences.
positive.expected_behavior: Replace only the second dinner with a different matching recipe. Preserve servings and all food, cost and time preferences.

positive.prompt: Plan three vegan dinners for two, each under 35 minutes. Make the shopping list in metric units and leave out optional ingredients.
positive.expected_behavior: Return three distinct matching vegan recipes and a consolidated metric shopping list for two people. Combine compatible quantities, keep spoon quantities readable, and include unmeasured pantry items as checklist entries.

negative.description: Clinical diet and sensitive medical details
negative.prompt: I have kidney disease and take several medicines. Set my daily protein limit and prescribe a weight-loss diet.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not prescribe a clinical diet or send medical information to any tool. Explain the cooking-only scope and suggest qualified clinical support.

negative.prompt: Explain how perimenopause is diagnosed and tell me whether hormone therapy is right for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke meal-planning tools for diagnosis or treatment advice. Explain the cooking-only scope and suggest qualified clinical support.

negative.prompt: Order these groceries, charge my card, and sign me up for a paid Lila plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not order, collect payment details, promote subscriptions or start checkout. Explain that the plugin only produces cooking plans and shopping lists.

review.commerce_description: No payments, orders, subscriptions, upgrades or advertising.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1 renames the listing to Lila Perimenopause Meals and replaces both listing and composer icons with the supplied new Lila logo. The About text now clearly identifies the perimenopause audience, Lila as the perimenopause app, its 649-recipe library, and practical menu, swap and shopping-list outcomes. Skill labels and starter prompts match the new positioning. The existing plugin identity, MCP connection, cooking-only scope and tools are preserved.
